༄༅/ /yang zlog me'i spu gri'i lo rgyus las/gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud rnams nas bshad pa'i

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yang zlog me'i spu gri'i lo rgyus las/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud rnams nas bshad pa'i

dam tshig gi rim pa rnams bzhugs so// bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing man ngag mnos te yi dam du 'dzin pa dag gi nyams len gyi gzhi ma dngos grub kyi rtsa bar gyur pa ni dam tshig gi tshogs yin la/ de dag gi bsrung bya dngos rnams ni rgyud dang man ngag gi gnad kyis bshad na/ rigs lnga spyi dang*/ bye brag /rtsa ba dang*/ sbom po/ yan lag gi dam tshig dang dbang bzhi so sor mnyam bzhag rjes thob bza' ba bca' ba bsrung ba ste/ lnga tshan re re bshad na dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs rnams ni gsang chen bla med pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs nas gsungs pa rnams yin la/ de rnams kyi steng du 'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud rnams nas khyad par dmigs bsal du gsungs pa rnams ni 'di lta ste/ 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa dam tshig bkod pa'i le'u las/ rtog dang bsrung dang gnas bya ba// spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i don// chos rnams ma lus kun gyi gzhi// sngags 'chang go 'phang bgrod pa'i srog /ngo bo chos sku byang chub sems/ /'khor 'das lhun grub ngang du rdzogs/ /thun mong rtsa ba yan lag gnyis// sku gsung thugs dang byang chub sems// yan lag mi spang ba lnga dang du blang ba lnga // bsgrub par bya ba lnga dang spyad par bya ba lnga dang shes pa lnga// bcu phrag gnyis dang lnga ru bshad// khyad par bsrung ba rnam gnyis la// bsrung ba nyi shu rtsa gcig bsrung ba nyi shu rtsa gcig las gang nyams kyang slob dpon la lha 'di'i dbang zhu ba'am yang na rang gis gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor bris la tshul dang mthun pa'i dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar blang ngo*// bkod// gcan gzan rgyal po bsad mi 1bya/ yul khams chos kyis skyong ba'i rgyal po mi gsod/

/za ma tog tu dug mi 2blug bla ma'i phyag rgya mar mi rol/ /rin chen lcug phran bcad mi3 bya/ bud med mtshan ldan mi gsod/ /gangs kyi zhun chu btung mi4 bya/ tshogs rdzas ma gtogs chang mi btung*/ /bug rdol snod du bcud mi 5blug snod min la gsang sngags mi sgrog /mi sha'i snod du mdangs mi 6phab/ yug sa ma phyag rgyar mi bsten/ /yid bzhin nor bu bsreg mi 7bya/ rang sems la mi 'tshe/ /bya khyung gshog pa bcag mi 8bya/ sngags kyi theg pa sun mi 'byin/ /gnam lcags ur mo nang mi 9'thab/ bla ma dang lha sngags gcig pa rdo rje nang dme mi bya/ /stag gzig rol mo lag mi snur10/ zhing bcu tshang ba nges par sgrol/ /rdo rjes gtam pa'i brag mi 11 bshig dam pa'i chos la mi 'tshe mi bshig /mun sel sgron me bsad mi 12bya/ rdo rje slob dpon mi gsod/ /rdo rje'i chu bo rkang mi 13bcag gsang sngags smin grol gyi rgyun mi gcod/ /rgyal po phyag rgya14 rtag mi dbye/ sngags chas dang mi 'bral zhing bris sku glegs bam phyag mtshan rdo rje sogs rtag par bcang zhing lha sngags ting nge 'dzin mi g.yel bar bya'o/ /rdo rje'i rdzong gi mkhar mi 15 bshig bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang ma bral bar dgos/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan rtse mi 16bcag ral pa mi breg /sngon byung ting 'dzin dogs pa 17bcad/ rang sems las gzhan pa'i lha med pas dogs gcod| |rdo rje'i dra ba'i rmang mi 18bshig bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang mi 'gal/ /ma btags nor dang rdzas mi 19bsre/ ma dag pa'i nor rdzas rang rang gis phar la mthu btang sa nas phul ba'i dgra'i nor rdzas mi len/ gal te len yang 'khon nag zas su za ba gal che/ /pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru kha mi 20dbye/ bud med la mi spyod/ /rdo rje'i rmang gi rigs mi 21bshig

chos spang gi las mi bya/ /khyad par dam tshig bsrung bar bshad// dngos grub nyams na rtsa ba rul// zur gyis nyams na 'bras bu rul// gzhung du bsrung na 'bras bu 'char// rgyun bsring don gyi man ngag 'grub// lhag ma dam tshig rnam gsum bstan// spyod pa lha sngags dang ma bral ba| rgyun dang rang bzhin lta ba brjod med don rtogs pa dang*// khyad par lhag pa rnam pa gsum bsnyen sgrub las sbyor la 'bad/ du bshad// sbyor ba sngags kyi 'khor lo las// ma yeng bsam gtan ting 'dzin skabs su gang bab kyi phrin las bzhi'i sngags kyi ting 'dzin brten// gsang ba'i lam min gzhan mi bya ba gang byed thabs shes zung 'jug kho na bya/ 'gro// rig pa'i mnga' la chos 'brel med pa dang theg dman la/ phyag mi 'tshal/ */mi smra bar ni sha chen za// g.yang gzhi stag lpags ro gos gyon// dur khrod gnas phyir phreng chen bgrang*// lta ba'i dam tshig chen po 'di// med pa 'chal ba gcig lta ba rtag chad gnyis las 'das pa/ pu nyid// ye 'byams ye nas ye gsal khyab/ bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po/ /ldog pa'i dam tshig lnga ru bshad// 'dun pa gsum lus lha ngag sngags yid ting 'dzin/ gyi brten pa bdag |dbang bskur gnyis kyi bstan pa bgro/ spros bcas spros med gnyis/ /lta ba bzhi gzugs snang lha sgra grag sngags dran rtog ting 'dzin rnam gsum ngo bo nyid las 'das pa ste bzhi'o// yi nyams stobs ldan// gsang ba gsum gyis rang dbang sdud// 'phags pa 'jam dpal dri ma med pa gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u drug pa dam tshig bstan pa'i le'u las/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// dam tshig khyad par bstan pa ni// dam tshig 'bum sde sa ma ya// thun mong khyad par 'dus pa ste// de las thun mong dam tshig ni// dam tshig nyi shu rtsa brgyad po// rtsa ba sku gsung thugs yin no// thun mong sgron ma lta bu'o// bla ma gtsug gi nor bur bskur// ngag gi las su gsang sngags brjod// gsang ba gzhan du mi smra zhing*// mnyam pa'i don la ma yengs pa// sku

gsung sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 'di rnams gang rung 'gal yang bsrung ba nyer gcig gi skabs ltar dbang gis gso bar bya'o// thugs kyi dam tshig go// yan lag dam tshig bstan pa ni// mi spang ba lnga/ dang dang du blang*| ba lnga/ /spyad par bya ba lnga/ dang shes pa lnga// bsgrub par bya ste dam tshig nyi shu lnga// g.yel ba med par bsrung bar bya// dam tshig bka' la gang gnas pa// yon tan yid bzhin gter ltar 'byung*// de dag thun mong dam tshig ste// khyad par dam tshig 'di dag go// bdag nyid lha mchod gnas pa la// bdag tu 'dzin pa spang bya ste// lta ba spyod pa gnyis med pa'i// smyung ba dag la gnas pa'i tshe/ */stag lpags gyon la bgrod dkar 'gro/ */gdug pa dom gyi pags dmar 'ding*// sdigs mdzub bsgreng zhing be con 'phyar// seng ldeng be yi og 'khar 'khar ba| bzung*// zas sha lnga/ dang skom bdud rtsi lnga/ du bdud rtsi za// mi rkang mchog bla phur snying phur srog phur gsum/ phur mtshon du thogs// phyag chos 'brel med pa dang theg pa dman pa la/ mi 'tshal zhing lam mi bzur// ral pa muñdza cod pan mgo bo'i skra mi breg par bcing*/ bcings// ma yeng mtshon chen rnam rtog ma rig pa 'joms byed bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i lta ba/ ral gri 'chang*// 'di dag khyad par dam tshig ste// gshin rje'i gshed po'i thugs dam mo// zhes dang*/ 'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u dgu pa dam tshig spyod pa rgyun gyi le'u las/ dpal lha dang*/ dang gu ru bla ma dang*/ spun la byams/ rdo rje mched dang skad cig tsam yang mi 'tshe/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar rgyun du gnas// gnas sa gzhan la spro ba min/ yid tha mal du mi gtong*/ /cha lugs longs spyod rdzogs pa/ dag la bya ba/ rab tu bstod// bsnyen sgrub dus la rab tu 'bad// dur khrod rdzas

sha chen spos khrag chen ar+ghaṃ tshil chen gyi mar me dang thod rnga rkang gling sogs/ la dus su 'dud// sgrub dang gu ru bla ma bsten/ dag la ni// las rnams ma lus rab 'byams brtsags// rtsa ba'i sngags gsum po gang rung*/ dang sa mā dhi/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ /dus su rtag tu rgyun du gnas/ ma chag par bya/ /sku yi dam pa gsung mthun rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig/ la// rgyun du nam yang dam du gnas// dpa' gtum tsha rngam spyod par bya/ bskyed rdzogs kyi gdeng dang ldan pa'i gzugs can gzugs med gang la'ang ya nga ba med pa'i/ /sdigs mdzub phyar zhing gdug pa 'dul/ dgra bgegs zhing bcu tshang ba nges par bsgral/ /dus gsum dag phyir gshin rje'i gshed 'di'i smin grol shes mkhan gyi/ yab rdo rje slob dpon de/ la ni// rtag tu dad pa rab tu bya// de la gnas na las rnams 'grub/ */snying rjes byang chub thob pa med// bsgral zhing bcu tshang ba/ bas lugs dang byang sems rtogs// sku gsum spyod lam rtag gnas na// sdom pa ma lus spyod pa yin gyi mchog 'di nyid yin no/ /ma nyams gzhung dang gso dang bskang*// las rnams kun la rab brtson na// rnal 'byor zhes kyang de dus grags// dus gsum dgu gsum la mchod pa dang gtor ma bya/ rnam par mchod pas mchod// 'du 'dzi spangs la dgon par gnas// gsang sngags sgra dang spyod pa rnams// gzhan gyis mi mthong thos mi bya// tshogs rgyun sha dang khrag la rol| |dur khrod ras ni gdug pa la// gshin rje'i gshed po bri zhing 'chang*// mchod dang maṃ sa zas su za// rgyun dang rtag tu gnas pa na// ci 'dod las rnams 'grub par nges// lha sku yi bzhin ras dang zhal phyag sogs dang ngo bo nyid ni// rtogs dang snang dang dngos po kun// rtog pa log pa ma yin te// de nyid

rang rig sku dang sku ru snang*// rang nyid de ltar rang sems yi dam du gdod nas dag pa ma rtogs par// 'khrul sems ngan par 'dug pa ste// 'khor ba'i sngags pa de 'dra gnas nas thar mi srid// sngags pa 'ga' zhig gis zhe sdang rgyu ru byas nas su// bsad dang bsgral ba'i zhe bzhag nas// gzhi la sangs rgyas yod kyang 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgyu/ byas so/ /dus dang de bas rnam pa thams cad du// bdag nyid dpal chen gshin rje'i sku// g.yas dang g.yon ni sbyor dang sgrol// mdun nas gshin rje'i sprul pa 'phro// thams cad khro bo'i tshogs dang rol// sprul pa ma lus tshogs su snang*// gzhi ni dur khrod 'bar ba'i gnas/ rang gi gnas gang yin| |dang po gnas pa dag bya'i phyir// sku lnga 'khor lo'i tshul du bsgom// rang phung po rgyal ba rigs lnga dang nyon mongs lnga ye shes lnga 'byung ba lnga yum lnga sogs su gsal btab ste bsgom/ rang gnas su gsal ba dang*| |sgrub dang bzlas pa gsang nas sbyin// zhes gsungs pa dang*// rtsa rgyud sdig pa snying 'dzing gi le'u bco lnga pa las/ byang sems bka' dang lung bor med/ rdo rje slob dpon ci 'dra yang mi spang spun rdo rje mi brnyas// sangs rgyas bka' mos pa bya la nges par bkur// bla ma dkon mchog yi dam dus kun tu mchod// bdag gzhan byang chub kun rdzob don dam sems mi bsad// don gyi lam stor theg pa 'og ma la// gsang sngags brda lam gzhan gyi rgyud ma sbyang bar dang dbang mi smra// yongs su ma sbyang sbyangs pa rnams theg pa rim gyis tshad mas sbyar// theg pa dman la nyan rang la chos mi bshad// bka' la tshad ma'i sgras gsang sngags la mi gzhal// dad ldan mi ldog phyag rgya bsten// rin po che yi rtsar mi dkrug rgyud kyi bshad pa dang smin grol sogs go rim mi dkrug

|rnal 'byor rim gnyis kyis mi smad gsang a+yai a+yai a+yai sngags bzla// drod rmi lam rtags dbang po rang nyams brtag /sems kyi me long phyag rgya chen po rtag tu blta// zhes pa rnams dam tshig tu gsungs so// des na gshin rje'i gshed la rnal 'byor bya ba rnams kyis ni gsang sngags kyi dam tshig /sdom pa/ rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig /smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi bslab bya rnams ni nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las bshad pa'i rgyal po la 'byung ba lnga/ blon po la 'byung ba lnga/ las dang po par 'byung ba brgyad/ rigs lnga bye brag gi dam tshig bcu bzhi/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi| rtsa ltung bcu bzhi po nyams kyang dbang gis gso zhing*/ sbom po dang yan lag sogs dam tshig gzhan thams cad bshags tshul ltung ba'i rnam bshad du rtogs par byas la 'dir bshad pa'i bsrung ba nyi shu dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig /rtsa ba'i dam tshig rgyud lung nas drangs pa rnams nyams na dbang gis gso zhing gzhan rgyud nas bshad pa rnams gang nyams kyang bskang bshags tshogs brgya dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sogs skabs thob kyis gso dgos/ phran bu rnams yig brgya sogs kyis gso dgos pa skabs thob zhal las shes so// sbom po brgyad/ yan lag rnams dang*/ dbang bzhi re rer dam tshig lnga phrag re re dang bcas pa'i steng du/ khyad par gyi dam tshig 'di nyid rang gi rgyud rnams nas gsungs pa gong du smos pa rnams srog dang mig 'bras ltar ma nyams par bsrungs te gal te nyams na phyir bcos kyi cho ga'ang dus las ma 'da' bar byed pa shin tu gal che zhing*/ tshul 'di rnams ni rdo rje theg pa'i dngos grub kyi rmang rdo lta bu yin pas shin tu gces par bsrung dgos so// zhes pa'ang bod kyi bla ma kha cig gi spyi brtol gyi bstan bcos kyi ngag sgros dang cal 'drogs zer zlos kyi rjes su ma 'brang bar rang nyid kyi mig lam du bstar ba'i rgyud rnams nas dam tshig gi rim pa'i le'u rnams khol phyung du bris pa ste shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas so// tshul 'di ni 'bri gung pa rig sngags 'chang ba gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa/
chos kyi grags pas lcags lug mgo zla ba'i bzang po la pho brang bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
